answer_1.quote: We study the effect of input length on model performance, while keeping other factors as constant as possible. We employ a methodology to measure model performance trends as a function of input length, by isolating it as a variable, while keeping the underlying task intact ( §2). To that end, we introduce Flexible LENgth Question Answering dataset (FLenQA) , a QA dataset for text-based reasoning ( §3).
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are True/False answers to questions requiring reasoning over two pieces of information in the input text.

answer_2.quote: We prompt models to complete the next word in a given text, and the output is correct if it is an exact match to the true next word.
